wholesale_note: Cross-border CBDC experimentation with Central Bank of Egypt (World Bank-supported); Jouahri said CBDC could take wholesale and retail forms.
notes: CONFLICT: wafir.ma (2026-05-18) claims BAM launched a 6-month e-Dirham pilot on 14 May 2026 with 50,000 testers and public launch June 2027, citing no BAM document; North Africa Post (2026-10-12) reports BAM completed initial technical tests with no pilot or launch date announced. No bkam.ma page found; treat the pilot claim as unverified. Secondary source (press report of Governor's press conference).

status_basis: Then-Governor !Gawaxab (Dec 2025) said the Bank of Namibia could introduce a CBDC 'within the next five to ten years'; no formal discussion paper or decision; IMF technical assistance on retail CBDC exploration (report Feb 2025).
notes: Governor statement reported by Republikein/The Brief (Dec 2025-Jan 2026); governor left office 31 Dec 2025. Source URL is the IMF TA report (official, prepared for BoN); no BoN CBDC page found.

status_basis: National Bank of North Macedonia (Governor Angelovska) began initial activities in 2022 to consider 'the possibility and need' of introducing a digital denar; per statements to RFE/RL (Jan 2025) no final decision and no timeline.
notes: Secondary source (RFE/RL) quoting NBRNM; no dedicated NBRNM CBDC page found.

status_basis: BCP Resolution 7/21 created a Working Group on Digital Money (CBDC) to 'monitorear las diferentes iniciativas a nivel internacional sobre CBDC' and assess implications of a possible CBDC; no decision or pilot.
notes: Latest official BCP statement found is from 2021 (also Informe SGGOF 029/2021); 2022 BCP conferences on a guarani digital; a Feb 2025 opinion piece says Paraguay remains in research phase.

status_basis: BNR director Ruxandra Avram said BNR 'joined a majority of European central banks' on a CBDC that would complement cash and participates in BIS CBDC work; BNR board member Csaba Balint later described a 'prudent approach' with an office analysing the technology.
notes: No official BNR page or recent statement on a digital leu found; sources are press reports (2021; capital.ro undated). Romania is an EU member outside the euro area; BNR commentary focuses on the ECB digital euro. Could arguably be coded NONE.

status_basis: NBS proposed amendments to the NBS Law giving it the 'isključivo pravo izdavanja dinara u digitalnom obliku (digitalni dinar)' while stating it is closely monitoring CBDC developments and analysing benefits and risks.
notes: Secondary press; NBS primary text not fetched; adoption of the amendment not verified. Earlier (Jan 2023) NBS said it was 'u fazi razmatranja i analize opravdanosti i efekata uvođenja digitalnog dinara'. No decision to issue found.

status_basis: MAS (parliamentary reply, 2 Mar 2022): 'the case for a retail CBDC in Singapore is not compelling'; MAS will continue to prepare for a possible digital Singapore dollar but 'does not see an immediate case for doing so'.
wholesale_note: Wholesale: SGD wholesale CBDC trialled for interbank overnight lending (DBS, OCBC, UOB); MAS announced (Nov 2025) a trial of tokenised MAS bills settled with wholesale CBDC, details in 2026; Project Orchid/purpose-bound money work.
notes: Coded EXPLORATION rather than PAUSED because MAS explicitly continues preparatory work (Project Orchid); PAUSED is a defensible alternative. Source is Mondo Visione repost of the MAS parliamentary reply (mas.gov.sg original not fetched). Statement >12 months old; later MAS remarks (e.g. Menon 2023) consistent.

status_basis: Riksbank Payments Report 2026 recommends the Riksdag and Government set up an inquiry into legal changes enabling an e-krona 'within reasonable time' if the Riksdag decides; suggested once the digital euro regulation is agreed and the ECB decides to issue. Riksbank: 'As yet no decision has been taken.'
notes: No decision to issue; e-krona pilot technical work (2020-2023) ended, now at policy/legislative-preparation recommendation stage. Not PAUSED: the Riksbank actively recommends preparing legislation.

status_basis: CBTT conducted feasibility research with IMF technical assistance and said (Feb 2022) it expected 'to be very close to a decision on a possible pilot' by mid-2022; no subsequent decision or pilot reported.
notes: No official CBTT CBDC statement after 2022 found; 2023 Annual Report mentions CBDC only in a G-24 topics list; Apr 2026 five-year plan coverage mentions digitisation, PSS Bill and CAPSS pilot but not CBDC. Possibly dormant; secondary source (HRF tracker).

status_basis: NBU Deputy Governor Oleksiy Shaban: the planned e-hryvnia pilot is costly and spending on it in wartime may be unethical; 'We are moving forward, but I cannot say that 2027 will be the year the e-hryvnia is implemented.'
notes: Press widely reported this as the NBU 'postponing' the e-hryvnia launch, but no formal pause was declared and the pilot (planned for 2025) has not started; no decision on issuance. Secondary source (Forbes Ukraine); NBU's own e-hryvnia Draft Vision (2023) on bank.gov.ua. No 2026 update found.

status_basis: Bank of England: the digital pound remains in the design phase; findings 'will support a joint assessment by the Bank and HM Treasury, ahead of a decision on next steps in 2026'.
wholesale_note: BoE wholesale/tokenisation work (RTGS synchronisation, Digital Securities Sandbox) separate from the digital pound.
notes: Decision on whether to proceed still pending as of 2026-10-14 (paymentexpert); Deputy Governor Breeden suggested the UK may not need a retail digital pound 'that quickly'. Primary legislation would be required before issuance.

status_basis: BCU payments roadmap 2023-2025 commits to 'elaborar un marco conceptual y propuesta de hoja de ruta para la emisión de una moneda electrónica'; the 2017-18 e-Peso retail pilot concluded in April 2018.
notes: Real-value retail e-Peso pilot ran Nov 2017-Apr 2018 (up to 10,000 users) and ended as planned; tokens were destroyed. Could alternatively be coded DISCONTINUED (pilot ended). BCU continues research (Working Paper 2.2025, May 2025). BCU president Labat prioritised the fast payment system. Secondary source.

status_basis: BCEAO Annual Report 2025: 'As studies continued on the idea of a Central Bank Digital Currency (CBDC), implementation procedures were validated for the Proof of Concept (PoC) phase', phase one having been completed at end-2024.
notes: Annual Report 2025 presented in Dakar on 2026-07-22 (English version file dated 2026-08). Press (Financial Afrik, 2026-07-23) describes the BCEAO as moving 'avec prudence' on an 'éventuelle MNBC'. No official name; 'e-CFA' appears only in unofficial press. BCEAO priority in 2025 was the PI-SPI instant payment platform (launched 2025-09-30).

status_basis: RBA and Treasury 'maintain that there is currently no clear public interest case for issuing a retail CBDC in Australia'; the RBA will keep monitoring 'to reassess the case for a retail CBDC should circumstances (and the policy case) change'.
wholesale_note: Project Acacia (wholesale CBDC / tokenised settlement) completed May 2026; RBA continuing a work program on wholesale tokenised finance.
notes: Classified PAUSED under the brief's 'no plans for now' reading; the RBA does not use the word 'pause' (wording is 'no clear public interest case'). Reaffirms the 2024 RBA-Treasury assessment. Media release: https://www.rba.gov.au/media-releases/2026/mr-26-24.html

status_basis: Bank of Canada: 'With this work completed, and with other payments issues gaining prominence, the Bank is scaling down its work on a retail central bank digital currency and shifting its focus to broader payments system research and policy development.'
notes: Statement announced ~19 Sep 2024 (press coverage dated 20 Sep 2024); quote taken from the official digital dollar page (last modified 2026-07-13). BoC adds it 'will continue to monitor global retail CBDC developments and publish some related research.' Older than 12 months -> medium.

status_basis: Banco de la República study concluded that 'por ahora no hay razones que justifiquen la emisión de una MDBC minorista en Colombia' (for now there are no reasons justifying a retail CBDC), preferring to develop the instant payment system.
wholesale_note: Same study saw no use case justifying a wholesale CBDC in the short term.
notes: Classified PAUSED under 'no plans for now'. Statement older than 12 months; no newer official statement found. BanRep's priority is the Bre-B instant payment system.

status_basis: BCCR: 'Por el momento, no considera necesario incursionar en el lanzamiento de una moneda digital' (for now it does not consider it necessary to launch a digital currency), as SINPE already delivers the main CBDC benefits.
notes: 'No plans for now' statement (coded PAUSED per brief), but no CBDC project was ever started, so NONE is a defensible alternative. Statement is >12 months old; no newer BCCR CBDC statement found (2024 BIS paper with BCCR staff on SINPE Movil does not mention CBDC).

status_basis: Danmarks Nationalbank (Dec 2017) 'has no plans to introduce central bank digital currency'; Analysis No. 8 (23 Jun 2022) maintained that 'it is not clear how retail CBDCs will create significant added value' and that it will monitor developments.
wholesale_note: Danmarks Nationalbank participates in Eurosystem Appia (wholesale DLT ecosystem blueprint by 2028) per ECB press release 21 Sep 2026.
notes: Explicit 'no plans' wording (coded PAUSED per brief); no retail project was started after 2016-17 e-krone consideration, so NONE is a defensible alternative. Statements are >12 months old. 2022 analysis: https://www.nationalbanken.dk/media/z12aimyo/analysis-no-8-new-types-of-digital-money.pdf

status_basis: ECCB Monetary Council at its 112th meeting (13 Feb 2026) 'approved the suspension of DCash 2.0 development' to prioritise a regional Fast Payment System and the CARICOM payments and settlement pilot.
notes: Official 112th communique not reachable on eccb-centralbank.org; wording from press reports (Antigua Observer, Discover Montserrat 16 Feb 2026). DCash 1.0 public pilot (live 2021) was ended in Jan 2024; the July 2026 113th communique mentions only the Fast Payment System, no DCash. DISCONTINUED is a defensible alternative given the pilot ended and the successor is suspended.

status_basis: RBNZ: 'We have paused work on Digital Cash while we focus on modernising New Zealand's payments system.'
notes: Pause date from news reports (Newsquawk/ODT, 13 Oct 2026); RBNZ page itself shows no date. Prior stage: 2024 public consultation on design.

status_basis: Norges Bank concluded that 'introducing a central bank digital currency is currently not warranted, but that it may be so in the future'; it will continue exploring tokenisation and CBDC forms to be able to introduce one if needed.
wholesale_note: Norges Bank exploring tokenisation and wholesale CBDC (Staff Memo 1/2026 on tokenised deposits and wholesale CBDC); experimental testing with industry.
notes: Decision announced 2025-12-10; final report (Norges Bank Papers 1/2026) published 2026-03-24. Media described it as 'shelving' CBDC plans. Classified PAUSED ('not warranted currently').

status_basis: BSP Governor Remolona: the central bank 'does not see a reason to issue a retail CBDC'; focus limited to a wholesale CBDC.
wholesale_note: Project Agila wholesale CBDC pilot (tokenised interbank payments, Hyperledger Fabric); testing concluded, BSP says not production-ready (reported Jul 2026). BSP earlier targeted a wholesale CBDC within ~2 years.
notes: Statement reported by Inquirer (secondary; archived); no BSP primary page found. Classified PAUSED under 'no plans for now'. Earlier retail-oriented Project CBDCPh ended 2022.

status_basis: NBP (May 2021): 'NBP z rozwaga podchodzi do mozliwosci wprowadzenia cyfrowego zlotego i obecnie nie decyduje sie na jego emisje'; Ministry of Finance (18 Apr 2025): it 'nie prowadzi obecnie prac nad cyfrowym zlotym' and no decision on introduction has been taken.
notes: Latest NBP primary statement found is from 2021 (reported by bank.pl); 2025 source is a Ministry of Finance reply to Sejm interpellation 8807, not the central bank. 'Not currently deciding to issue' read as 'no plans for now' (PAUSED); EXPLORATION/NONE defensible alternatives.

status_basis: SARB Position Paper: 'the work done to date did not find a strong argument for South Africa to implement a retail CBDC in the short to medium term... The SARB will therefore continue to monitor developments relating to retail CBDC, without actively pursuing the implementation of a retail CBDC.'
wholesale_note: Project Khokha (wholesale DLT, 2018; phase 2 2022) concluded; SARB took part in BIS Project Dunbar (2022).
notes: Explicit 'without actively pursuing the implementation' wording. Reaffirmed by SARB Deputy Governor (Jun 2026): 'currently no compelling case for immediate implementation'; priority is Payments Ecosystem Modernisation / PayShap.

status_basis: SNB Chairman Jordan: 'the SNB currently sees no need in Switzerland for digital central bank money for the general public'; SNB CBDC page: 'the SNB currently does not see any clear advantages for the general public in its issuance of a digital franc'.
wholesale_note: Project Helvetia Phase III: SNB issues wholesale CBDC (tokenised CHF) on SIX Digital Exchange as a pilot; extended in June 2025 for two years; SNB says this does not mean permanent introduction of wholesale CBDC.
notes: Classified PAUSED under the 'no plans for now' reading (no retail project ever started; could alternatively be coded NONE). Dated statement is >12 months old, but the position is restated on the current SNB page https://www.snb.ch/en/snb-explained/cbdc (undated).

status_basis: BOT Retail CBDC Pilot Conclusion Report: 'the BOT has no immediate plan to officially issue Retail CBDC'; pilot insights to be applied to other payment-system work.
wholesale_note: Wholesale: Project Inthanon (DLT wholesale/tokenisation) and mBridge participation.
notes: Retail pilot concluded 2024. Baker McKenzie (Jan 2026) confirms BOT 'currently has no plans for full-scale retail CBDC issuance'. Older than 12 months -> medium. 'No immediate plan' read as PAUSED per brief ('no plans for now').

project_name: Dinero Electrónico (Sistema de Dinero Electrónico, BCE)
status_basis: BCE bulletin implementing Junta de Política y Regulación Monetaria y Financiera Resolution 435-2018-M: transactions wound down Feb-Mar 2018 with 'definitive deactivation' of e-money accounts on 16 April 2018.
notes: Central-bank-operated mobile e-money (2014-2018), usually counted as an early retail CBDC; closed after a 2017 law handed e-money to private banks. Source is a law-firm summary of the official BCE bulletin (official page not reached). Ecuador is dollarised; no current CBDC project found.

status_basis: MNB: the Student Safe app 'will be phased out soon'; 'the closure of the programme marks the end of an important chapter'; MNB describes it as 'the first CBDC pilot project in the European Union to be made available to retail users'.
notes: Service ended 3 Feb 2025 (per HRF tracker citing MNB; spokesperson: operation suspended 'until further priorities are determined'); MNB white paper Mar 2025. Whether Student Safe was a true CBDC is disputed (MNB labels it one). No successor retail CBDC project found. Announcement older than 12 months -> medium.

status_basis: Palau Ministry of Finance (head of digital residency Jay Hunter) ended the pilot: distribution stopped 8 Sep 2023, 'After Sept. 15, you will no longer be able to spend the PSC', pilot formally ending end-Sep 2023; any next phase subject to government authorisation.
notes: Palau has no central bank and uses the US dollar; PSC was a government-issued USD-backed token on the XRP Ledger (with Ripple), commonly listed in CBDC trackers. Official statement was an X post (https://twitter.com/JHX_1138/status/1699650336581882041); source is secondary press. No later phase found.

status_basis: Government closed Petro wallets: Plataforma Patria announced it 'cerrara los monederos y billeteras en criptomonedas' effective 15 Jan 2024, with remaining petros converted to bolivars.
notes: Petro (2018) was a government-issued oil-backed token (SUNACRIP), not issued by the Banco Central de Venezuela; whether it counts as a CBDC is contested (NONE is a defensible alternative). The 2021 'bolivar digital' was a redenomination, not a CBDC. No official Venezuelan government page reachable; secondary source (AFP via Portafolio).

status_basis: 21st Century ROAD to Housing Act (H.R. 6644, P.L. 119-101), Title XI Sec. 1101, bars the Federal Reserve from issuing a CBDC 'directly or indirectly through intermediaries' until 31 Dec 2030; House FSC: the Act 'includes a prohibition on the issuance of a Central Bank Digital Currency (CBDC) until December 31, 2030'.
notes: Temporary statutory moratorium (sunset 31 Dec 2030; exempts open, permissionless, private dollar-denominated currency). Became law 11 Jul 2026 WITHOUT the President's signature (10-day rule). Executive Order 14178 (23 Jan 2025) prohibits agencies from establishing, issuing or promoting CBDCs and terminated ongoing CBDC plans. H.R. 1919 (Anti-CBDC Surveillance State Act) passed House 17 Jul 2025 (219-210); Senate companion S. 1124 still in Senate Banking (no Senate passage found; congress.gov not fetchable). FY2026 NDAA: House-passed version carried anti-CBDC language but it was dropped from the final package (Dec 2025). Section/P.L. details from Holland & Knight (Aug 2026).

status_basis: BCB press release CP54/2025 sets a roadmap 'hasta 2026' for the gradual implementation of the Boliviano Digital, described as a CBDC 'con enfoque mayorista'; no retail CBDC project announced.
wholesale_note: Boliviano Digital: wholesale-focused CBDC; roadmap (technical dialogue, survey, second evaluation report, functional prototypes in controlled test environments) running to 2026 - exploration/PoC stage.
notes: Retail status coded NONE because the only official project is explicitly wholesale. Sep 2025 press reports of a 'launch' of the boliviano digital were not confirmed by an official retail launch. If the corpus treats Boliviano Digital as the national CBDC project, retail-agnostic coding would be EXPLORATION.

status_basis: BCB's Drex platform was designed as a wholesale CBDC with retail access via tokenised bank deposits (not a retail CBDC); in Aug 2025 BCB said Drex's first phase (2H 2026) will drop DLT/tokenisation and focus on reconciliation of liens (gravames).
wholesale_note: Drex (wholesale CBDC/tokenised-deposit platform): pilot phases 2023-2025; first production phase planned 2H 2026 without DLT, focused on collateral/lien reconciliation.
notes: Official BCB Drex page (bcb.gov.br/estabilidadefinanceira/drex) not machine-readable; source is a republication of a Valor Economico interview with BCB Drex coordinator Fabio Araujo. Classification is contested: trackers (Atlantic Council/HRF) code Brazil as PILOT because Drex pilots included retail-facing tokenised deposits; under the brief's retail-CBDC rule it is NONE. Whether 2H 2026 phase actually went live was not confirmed.
